fusions.name: Furnace Door
fusions.desc: Swings the heated shield open and lets the heat out in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 12 damage to everything in it, knocking it back 2 tiles and setting it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flashover
fusions.desc: Presses the red-hot boss into a failing enemy, which deals 16 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Ember Palisade
fusions.desc: Raises a palisade of flame 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Too Hot to Strike
fusions.desc: When a blow lands on you from anything but fire, a bolt leaps from the shield to the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 6 damage, and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 4 seconds.
